title: Gooseworks (YC W23) Is Hiring a Founding Engineer to Build Self-Improving AI Ad Creative Engines
summary: Gooseworks, a Y Combinator-backed startup, is hiring a Founding Engineer/Builder to develop self-improving AI agents for growth marketing. The company focuses on automating ad creative generation, performance analysis, and optimization for consumer brands. With 200+ paying customers and 30,000+ AI-generated creatives, Gooseworks aims to replace manual creative processes with AI-driven solutions. The role requires strong full-stack engineering skills, experience with AI agents, and product thinking. Equity and competitive salary offered.
key_points: Gooseworks builds self-improving AI agents for ad creative generation and growth marketing, targeting consumer brands.
The company has 200+ paying customers and has generated 30,000+ ad creatives in the last two months.
The Founding Engineer role combines engineering excellence with product thinking, focusing on AI-driven creative generation and multi-channel distribution.
Key responsibilities include building creative generation agents, scaling distribution architecture, and developing self-improving AI systems.
Requirements: strong technical background, experience with AI agents, product/design sense, and early-stage startup experience.
Preferred skills: TypeScript/Next.js, motion/video skills, and prior startup experience.
Stack: TypeScript, Express, Prisma, Postgres, Next.js, React, Tailwind, Claude Agent SDK, and Trigger.dev.
Location: San Francisco (in-person preferred), with remote options for exceptional candidates.
The company was founded in 2022, is part of YC W23 batch, and has a team of 5.
